premises.text: Digital play experiences are isolating compared to physical play.
premises.evidence_span: It's all digital, it's isolating, and the interactions happen through devices.

premises.text: Tangible Play combines physical objects with digital gaming.
premises.evidence_span: Imagine board games, meet video games.

premises.text: The product uses an iPad accessory to capture the surface in front of it.
premises.evidence_span: what we have is a simple iPad accessory that redirects iPad's front camera to capture the surface in front of it.

premises.text: The AI software runs locally without Wi-Fi dependencies.
premises.evidence_span: it runs all locally. No Wi-Fi dependencies, it will work at grandma's house as well.

premises.text: The games will be affordable, priced between $15 to $30.
premises.evidence_span: the price for the base less than $30. The games will be somewhere between $15 to $30, really affordable.

premises.text: There is a growing market for hybrid games.
premises.evidence_span: there's a fast-growing, multi-billion-dollar trend of hybrid games.

value.text: Tangible Play enhances social interaction through hybrid gaming experiences.
value.evidence_span: one of the great things about board games is they are inherently social.

notes: No separate premises for future platform potential as they are speculative.
